# Analytics Engineer — Northwind Health Analytics

**Northwind Health Analytics** helps regional clinics understand patient demand and plan staffing. We process anonymised scheduling and billing data from more than two hundred clinics, and our data team of fourteen people is growing to support new products.

## About the role

As an Analytics Engineer you will own the transformation layer between raw clinic data and the dashboards our customers rely on. You will work with data scientists, product managers and backend engineers to make sure the numbers are correct, documented and delivered on time.

## What you will do

- Design and maintain dbt models on top of Snowflake, with tests and documentation for every model.
- Build and operate batch pipelines in Python and Apache Airflow, including backfills and failure alerting.
- Write performant SQL for large fact tables and tune warehouse cost.
- Process large datasets with Spark when SQL is not enough.
- Define metrics with stakeholders and keep a single, trusted definition for each.
- Investigate data quality incidents and write clear post-incident notes.

## Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in data or analytics engineering.
- Strong SQL and Python.
- Hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt and a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake.
- Experience with Spark or a comparable distributed processing framework.
- Clear written communication with non-technical stakeholders.

## Nice to have

- Experience with healthcare or other regulated data.
- Familiarity with infrastructure as code and CI for data projects.
